meta.title: Reorder fields with the 6-dots drag-and-drop
gaps: Drag specifically by the field's six-dots handle rather than by the field element text.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Drag specifically by the field's six-dots handle rather than by the field element text.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen for an RFQ sheet.
Configure the event with an RFQ pricing stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the sheet fields render.
Add a line item so the pricing sheet is populated.
Render and populate the sheet before reordering its fields.
Move the Price field before Product, representing the requested field reorder.
Assert that the sheet's field order reflects the drop position.
